purpose: Teach: レフ/栄養素/ボーイング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室でレフ、つまりレフ板を撮影に使え
lines.en: Ren, in the lab, use a ref for the photography — a reflector board, that is.
lines.style: Firm mentor's opening, name landed first; deliberate pace, a small clarifying softening mid-line.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被験者の栄養素摂取記録を取ります
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll keep records of the test subjects' nutrient intake.
lines.style: Quick eager compliance; slightly breathless, the over-precise diction of a student wanting approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ボーイング社の航空力学論文を読め
lines.en: Ren, read Boeing's papers on aerodynamics.
lines.style: Short dry directive; low steady pitch, weight on the company name, nothing elaborated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。栄養素の代謝研究の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll read the studies on nutrient metabolism as well.
lines.style: Earnest note-to-self energy; quick nodding rhythm, a faint lift of genuine academic interest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、レフ板を使った撮影技法も学べ
lines.en: And Ren — learn the shooting techniques that use those reflector boards, too.
lines.style: Closing instruction with quiet approval underneath; measured, final, a shade warmer than before.
